source: 583 Celestial Worthy’s Revelation
target: 583 Revelatio Dignitatis Caelestis

source: 583 Celestial Worthy’s Revelation
target: 583 Revelatio Dignitatis Caelestis

source: Around the betrothal ship and sailboat, thick turquoise vines cascaded from the sky.
target: Circum navem sponsalem et naviculam velis instructam, vites spissae caeruleae ex caelo descenderunt.

source: They entwined, creating a “road” leading to various destinations.
target: Se implicaverunt, viam creantes quae ad loca varia ducebat.

source: “Cinderella” returned to the orange-yellow pumpkin coach, pulled by gray mice swiftly descending through the vines.
target: “Cinderella” rediit ad currum cucurbitarium aurantioluteum, tractum a muribus cinereis celeriter per vites descendentibus.

source: They approached the energy passageway formed by pure light, as if about to enter the silver-gray behemoth embedded in the seabed.
target: Appropinquaverunt ad iter energiae, quod ex pura luce formato erat, quasi mox ingrediantur ingens monstrum argenteo‑cinereum in fundo maris insitum.

source: Abruptly, the mischief of gray mice came to a halt.
target: Subito, malitia murorum cinereorum cessavit.

source: “Cinderella,” adorned in a purple robe, wore a solemn expression, purple spots dancing in her pupils.
target: “Cinderella,” tunica purpurea induta, vultum solemnem gerebat, maculis purpureis in oculis saltantibus.

source: “Cinderella” sensed an unusually perilous presence deep within the silver‑gray behemoth.
target: “Cinderella” sensit praesentiam insolite periculosam alte in ingenti monstro argenteo‑cinereo.

source: It remained motionless, as if in a deep slumber or long dead.
target: Manebat immobile, quasi in profundo somno aut iam diu mortuum.

source: However, in either case, her intuition warned her not to approach, lest she suffer severe corruption or similar effects.
target: Tamen, in utraque re, eius intuitio eam monuit ne appropinquaret, ne graves corruptionis effectus aut similia incommoda subiret.

source: Staring at the energy passageway where Lumian and company had vanished, she deliberated for a few seconds before shifting her focus to the sailboat.
target: Intuens viam energeticam in qua Lumian et comites evanuerant, paulisper deliberavit antequam animum suum ad naviculam velis instructam vertit.

source: With Mr. Fool’s seal on the Seven of Wands and the sealed evil god’s angel, he didn’t have to worry about the problem that even she had to be wary of—as long as he didn’t directly see those things, hear its voice, or enter the core area.
target: Cum sigillo Domini Stulti in Septem Virgae et angelo dei mali sigillato, non curare debebat de re qua etiam illa cavere debebat, dummodo ille ea non directe videat, neque vocem eius audiret, neque in regionem nuclearem ingrediret.

source: As for the other one, he seemed to be a Shepherd, so he didn’t mind being even crazier.
target: Quod ad alterum attinet, videbatur esse Pastor; idcirco etiam insanior fieri ei non molestum erat.

source: “Cinderella” observed the mast and shipboard of the sailboat cracking under the terrifying suction of the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s “heaviness” characteristic.
target: “Cinderella” animadvertit mastem ac tabulam navis velis instructae, fractas sub terribili attrahitione proprietatis “gravitatis” Artificii Humanoidi Sigillati.

source: She was ready to make her move when she retrieved a Roselle chess piece from her dark-purple coin bag and hurled it at the target in the black nun’s attire.
target: “Cinderella” parata erat agere, cum ex sacculo nummorum purpureo‑obscuri partem scaccorum “Rosellae” extraxit et eam in scopum, indutum habitu monachae nigrae, proiecit.

source: Amidst the howling wind, the Queen chess piece soared towards the humanoid Sealed Artifact, accompanied by various miscellaneous items.
target: Inter ululantem ventum, regina scaccorum versus Artificium Humanoidem Sigillatum volavit, comitata variis rebus miscellaneis.

source: As it descended, the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s steps towards the sailboat slowed, as if time itself was warping around her.
target: Cum descendit, gressus Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati versus naviculam velis instructam retardabantur, quasi tempus ipsum circa eam torqueretur.

source: This was one of the spells of “Cinderella”—the Chessboard of Ages.
target: Hoc erat unum ex incantamentis “Cinderellae”—Tabula Scaccorum Aetatum.

source: It had the power to decelerate the target as if they had entered an area where time moved at a different speed.
target: Potentia erat ei scopum retardandi, quasi in regionem intravissent ubi tempus aliter moveretur.

source: Seizing the opportunity presented by the sluggish movement, “Cinderella” closed her eyes and transformed into a humanoid phantom, collapsing into the invisible coffin.
target: Occasio captata ex motu tardo, “Cinderella” oculos clausit et se in phantasmam humanoidem transformavit, in sarcophagus invisibilem corruens.

source: The eyelids of the humanoid Sealed Artifact drooped, as if she might succumb to sleep at any moment.
target: Palpebrae Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati trudebantur, quasi quovis momento somno succumbere posset.

source: Sleeping Beauty magic!
target: Magia Bellae Dormientis!

source: Witnessing this, Hela, aboard the sailboat, once again activated the Evernight pathway’s ability to forcibly drag people into a dream.
target: Hoc videns, Hela, in navicula velis instructa, iterum activavit facultatem semitis “Evernight”, quae homines vi coercitiva in somnium trahere facit.

source: Although the notarization wouldn’t immediately expire with Ultraman Lato Guiaro’s loss of the Governor of the Sea authority, it would still last until the end.
target: Quamquam notarizatio non statim exstinguetur ob damnum auctoritatis “Gubernator Maris” Ultraman Lato Guiaro, tamen usque ad finem permanebit.

source: However, the ability to be invalidated by notarization wasn’t entirely ineffective.
target: Attamen facultas notarizatione invalidandi non omnino ineficax erat.

source: It would only be weakened, and its effects would be significantly reduced.
target: Illud tantum debebat debilitari, et eius effectus notabiliter minuere.

source: Now, the humanoid Sealed Artifact was already fatigued, swaying and on the verge of falling asleep.
target: Nunc, Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati iam defessus erat, vacillans et prope ad somnum cadendum.

source: In this state, entering a dream was undoubtedly much easier.
target: In hoc statu, in somnium ingredi indubitanter multo facilius erat.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact, donned in a black nun’s attire, finally closed her eyes and plunged into a deep slumber.
target: Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati, habitu monachae nigrae induta, tandem oculos clausit et in profundum somnum incidit.

source: She entered a somewhat sorrowful dream, causing her face to contort slightly as she frowned.
target: Ingressa est in somnium aliquantulum tristis, unde facies eius leviter contorta facta est dum arruebatur.

source: On the sailboat, a dense darkness surged once more, enveloping the humanoid Sealed Artifact, resonating with a distant voice that brought peace and tranquility.
target: In navicula velis instructa, densum tenebrarum iterum effulsit, Humanoidem Artificium Sigillatam involvens, cum voce remota quae pacem et tranquillitatem afferebat.

source: It was akin to a mother reciting a poem to lull her child to sleep, fostering a serene slumber.
target: Id simile erat matri carmen recitanti ad infandum puerum suum, quod somnum serenum consolidabat.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact, still in her black nun’s attire, hovered in midair with her eyes tightly shut.
target: Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati, adhuc habitu monachae nigrae induta, in media aere levabatur, oculis stringentibus clausis.

source: She descended slowly, landing gracefully on the deck of the sailboat.
target: Lente descendit, eleganter ad tabulam navis velis instructae perveniens.

source: Her brows gradually relaxed, her face softened, and crystalline water droplets formed at the corners of her eyes.
target: Arcus oculorum eius paulatim relaxaverunt, facies mollita est, et guttae aquae crystallinae in angulis oculorum eius constitutae sunt.

source: The Maidens of the Sea, deputy hosts, and sailors, blessed by the sea and adorned with starlight scales, swiftly settled in the darkness, succumbing to sleep amidst the enchanting chanting.
target: Virginiae Maris, hospitum vicarii, et nautae, mari benedicti et squamis stellae ornati, celeriter in tenebris consederunt, sub somno incidentes inter incantationes amoenissimas.

source: Franca, within the sail cabin, was taken aback by the unfolding battle.
target: Franca, intra cellam navis velariae, obstupefacta est a pugna evolvente.

source: I‑isn’t that Cinderella?
target: Nonne illa “Cinderella” est?

source: I‑isn’t that Jack and the Beanstalk?
target: Nonne ille “Jack et Stipes Fabae” est?

source: What manner of magic is this?
target: Quae natura magicae haec est?

source: I‑isn’t that Sleeping Beauty?
target: Nonne illa “Bella Dormiens” est?

source: Who is this? Have I arrived in a fairyland?
target: Quis hic est? Num in terram fabularum perveni?

source: I have to admit, it’s truly dreamlike…
target: Fateri debeo, vere quasi somnium est…

source: Two demigods working together are undoubtedly formidable.
target: Duo semidei simul laborantes indubitanter formidabiles sunt.

source: They swiftly subdued the humanoid Sealed Artifact…
target: Celeriter superaverunt Humanoidum Artificium Sigillatam…

source: I also wish to become a demigod!
target: Ego quoque semideus fieri cupio!

source: A Demoness demigod would do too…
target: Etiam daemonissa semidea id efficere posset!

source: Regaining her senses, Franca concealed herself and sprinted out of the sailboat.
target: Sensuum revocata, Franca se abscondit et ex navicula velis instructa properavit.

source: Utilizing her run-up and an Assassin’s Feather Fall, she elegantly leaped onto the betrothal ship, intending to approach the energy passageway at the bow.
target: Utens impetu suo et “Assassin’s Feather Fall”, eleganter in navem sponsalem saliit, intendens ad iter energiae in prora ingredi.

source: Within the silver‑gray behemoth.
target: Intra ingens monstrum argenteo‑cinereum.

source: After Lumian traversed the energy passageway, he found himself not in the metal beehive he had seen before.
target: Postquam Lumian iter energiae pertransiit, se non invenit in alveo metallico, quem antea viderat.

source: Walking on the silvery‑white metal floor, he noticed a hall dozens of meters long and 20 to 30 meters wide ahead.
target: Ambulans super solum metallum argenteo‑album, animadvertit atrium decies metrorum longum et latum viginti ad triginta metrorum prae se.

source: In the middle of the hall, Ultraman Lato Guiaro stood, donning Simon Guiaro’s face, and shouted in delight, “(…¥#)”
target: In medio atrii, Ultraman Lato Guiaro stetit, vultum Simon Guiaro indutus, et exsultans clamavit, “(…¥#)”

source: This represented the first half of the command to activate the spaceship by entering the password and gaining access.
target: Hoc repraesentabat dimidiem partem mandati ad spatium navale activandum, per verbum clavis ingrediendo et accessum obtinendo.

source: However, there was no response from the spaceship.
target: Attamen, nullum responsum ex spatio navali venit.

source: Crap… It still holds ill intentions towards me and isn’t willing to grant access… This malice stems from that demigod’s ability.
target: Stercus… Adhuc in me mala consilia habet nec accessum concedere vult… Haec malitia ex illa facultate semidei oritur.

source: It shouldn’t last long. As long as I can stall for time, I should be able to regain control…
target: Non diuturnum manere debet. Dummodo tempus differre possim, rursus imperium recuperare debeam.

source: Can the humanoid Sealed Artifact hold back two demigods? Or can I rely on the spaceship’s internal layout to play “hide and seek?”
target: Num poterit Humanoide Artificium Sigillatum duo semideos repugnare? Aut in interno conspectu spatii navalis confidere possum ut ludem “latere et quaerere?”

source: A series of thoughts raced through Ultraman’s anxious mind.
target: Seriem cogitationum per animum anxium Ultramanis festinanter percurrerunt.

source: At that moment, through the translucent metal wall to the side of the hall, he saw “Cinderella” in the pumpkin coach come to a halt near the energy passageway, seemingly apprehensive about something.
target: Illo momento, per parietem metallicum translucidum ad latus atrii, vidit “Cinderella” in curru cucurbitario prope iter energiae sistentem, quasi aliquid timens.

source: As expected!
target: Ut exspectatum est!

source: She doesn’t dare to enter!
target: Non audet ingredi!

source: Exhilaration surged from Ultraman Lato Guiaro’s heart.
target: Exsultatio ex corde Ultraman Lato Guiaro effluit.

source: Before the mission kicked off, Loki had set up an altar and sought guidance from Celestial Worthy through divination.
target: Antequam missio inchoaretur, Loki aram constituit et ab “Dignitate Caelestis” per divinationem consilium petivit.

source: The response he got was: Contains a high risk from high‑ranking individuals. Avoidable by entering the spaceship.
target: Responsum, quod accepit, fuit: altum periculum ab personis summi gradus continet; per spatium navale intrando vitari potest.

source: Loki decoded this as a warning about Hela and Gandalf from the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, as well as the Saint from the Church of Earth Mother overlooking Port Santa.
target: Loki hoc interpretatus est ut monitionem de Hela et Gandalf ex Societate Inquisitionis Simiae Crinitæ, necnon de Sancto ex Ecclesia Matris Terrae, quae Portum Santae supervidebat.

source: These high‑ranking figures were the primary threats.
target: Hi personae summi gradus erant primae minae.

source: However, if he could take the reins of the mystical sci‑fi spaceship first, he believed he could outmaneuver these formidable opponents.
target: Attamen, si gubernare prius posset mystico spatio navali scifi, creditur se hos formidabiles adversarios superare posse.

source: Now, Lato Guiaro noticed that even without absolute control of the spaceship, the new demigod hesitated, as if haunted by an unseen fear.
target: Nunc, Lato Guiaro animadvertit quod, etiam absque absoluta gubernatione spatialis, novus semideus cunctaret, quasi invisibili metu infestaretur.

source: Facing something capable of unsettling a demigod left Lato Guiaro uneasy.
target: Obversus aliquid quod semideum commovere posset, Lato Guiaro inquietum reliquit.

source: However, armed with the spaceship’s command and password, he could soon turn potential threats to his advantage.
target: Attamen, instructus imperio et verbo clavis spatii navalis, mox potuit adversarias minas in utilitatem suam verti.

source: There was no need for fear.
target: Nulla erat necessitas timendi.

source: As Lumian was on the brink of “teleporting” behind Ultraman Lato Guiaro, they both heard a metallic clang.
target: Dum Lumian prope “teleportandum” post Ultraman Lato Guiaro esse videbatur, uterque clangorem metallicum audivit.

source: A silver metal door descended, sealing off the hall’s entrance and exit completely.
target: Porta metallica argentea descendit, ostium et exitum atrii omnino claudens.

source: The walls, ceiling, and floor transformed as metal surfaces shifted and revealed dark pipe openings.
target: Muri, laquearum, et solum transmutaverunt, cum superficies metallicae moverentur atque obscuras fistulas patefierunt.

source: Out gushed cerulean‑blue gas.
target: Gas caeruleus effluit.

source: Poison gas! Lato Guiaro’s heart raced as he grasped the situation.
target: Gas venenosum! Corde Lato Guiaro palpitabat, dum rem comprehenderet.

source: The spaceship, still imbued with malice, not only resisted control but also emanated lethal intent, seeking to eliminate him before its animosity subsided.
target: Spatium navale, adhuc malitia imbuta, non solum imperium repellebat sed etiam mortiferum intentum emanabat, quaerens eum delere priusquam animositas eius minuere cesseret.

source: The magic of the demigod outside is malicious indeed!
target: Magia semidei foris vere maligna est!

source: Lumian perceived this as an instinctive strike from the silver‑gray behemoth against intruders.
target: Lumian hoc perceptus est ut impetum instinctivum ab ingenti monstro argenteo‑cinereo adversariis incideret.

source: Swiftly, he tapped into the power of the sea, aiming to invoke the temporary authority of the Governor of the Sea to counter the threat.
target: Celeriter, ad potentiam maris recurrens, constitui auctoritatem temporariam Gubernatoris Maris evocare ad minas oppugnandas.

source: He could sense that Ultraman had lost the Governor of the Sea’s position after the attack from the “Cinderella” demigod, with no immediate prospect of reclaiming it.
target: Sentiebat Ultramanis locum Gubernatoris Maris post impetus semidei “Cinderellae” amittere, cum nullo proposito statim recuperandi.

source: With no contenders for the authority, Lumian anticipated an easy acquisition.
target: Cum nulli ad auctoritatem contenderent, Lumian facilis acquisitionem exspectabat.

source: Yet, the “waters” resisted, refusing Lumian the temporary position of Governor of the Sea.
target: Attamen, “aquae” repellebant, Lumiano locum temporarium Gubernatoris Maris recusantes.

source: Its malice seemed directed at anyone attempting control!
target: Malis eius videbatur destinata esse cuique gubernare conanti!

source: Undeterred, Lumian shifted his focus back to Ultraman Lato Guiaro, a crucial member of April Fool’s.
target: Non perturbatus, Lumian animum rediit ad Ultraman Lato Guiaro, membro cruciario “Aprilis Stultorum.”

source: Lato Guiaro’s heart stirred as he shouted, “Do you want to fight here? If we don’t break out and waste no time, we’ll all die!”
target: Corde Lato Guiaro commotus, clamavit: “Vultisne hic pugnare? Nisi exiremus et tempus non amittamus, omnes peribimus!”

source: In this dire moment, a plan to escape the hall and relocate became paramount.
target: In hoc momento critico, consilium ex atrio effugere et se alibi collocare praevaluit.

source: The malice wouldn’t linger for long.
target: Mala intentio non diu maneret.

source: Seek vengeance in a safe space. If we perish here, who will assist in eliminating the others?
target: Vindictam quaerite in loco tuto. Si hic perimus, quis alios elidere adiuvabit?

source: Lumian nonchalantly flexed his wrists, donning the Flog boxing gloves, and grinned, stating,
target: Lumian nonchalanter bracchia flexit, manicas pugilisticas “Flog” induens, et subridens dixit:

source: “I don’t care about my own death. All that matters now is one thing: Ending you!”
target: “Meam mortem non curo. Nunc una res refert: te interficere!”

source: As the words left his lips, crimson flames, bordering on white, erupted from his entire being, as if he were cloaked in a fiery shroud.
target: Cum verba ex labris eius exierunt, flammæ rubræ, quasi album extremum attingentes, ex tota vita eius eruperunt, quasi in velamine igneo obtectus esset.

source: Not far from Lumian and Lato Guiaro, Mad Lady and Mr. K found themselves in the beehive‑like metal room, unable to enter the hall ahead.
target: Non longe a Lumiano et Lato Guiaro, Mad Lady et Dominus K se in conclavi metallico, simili alveario, invenerunt, qui in atrium antecessum intrare non poterant.

source: Surveying the surroundings, Mr. K’s gaze swept across the incubating Batings Black Insect, Little Devils, and other creatures.
target: Circumspiciens, Dominus K oculus pertransivit Batings Insectum Nigerum, Parvos Diaboli, et alias creaturas.

source: He nodded in satisfaction.
target: Annuit ex satisfactione.

source: “It’s indeed the power of an evil god, spawn of an evil god. Well done, Lumian! Well done! This is all part of God’s arrangement!”
target: “Revera haec est potentia dei mali, generatio dei mali. Bene, Lumiane! Bene! Haec omnia pars sunt dispositionis Dei!”

source: Amidst the hoarse voice, the Aurora Order Oracle turned his gaze back to Mad Lady.
target: Inter vocem raucam, Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae oculos suos iterum ad Mad Lady vertit.

source: Mad Lady wasn’t intimidated. Instead, she applauded in agreement with Mr. K.
target: Mad Lady non timuit. Immo, una cum Domino K plausit in consensu.

source: She spoke as if they were on different frequencies.
target: Loquebatur quasi in diversis frequentiis essent.

source: “That’s right, it’s cool, right? This is a spaceship!”
target: “Ita est, mirum est, nonne? Hic est spatium navale!”

source: In the next moment, Mad Lady and Mr. K vanished simultaneously and reappeared behind where the other party had been standing, as if they had negotiated a position switch beforehand.
target: In momento sequenti, Mad Lady et Dominus K simul evanuerunt et reapparuerunt post locum ubi altera pars stabat, quasi antea de permutatione locorum convenissent.
